product.name: Monoprice Desktop Computer Power Cord - IEC 60320 C14 to NEMA 5-15R 18AWG 10A/1250W SVT 125V Black 1ft
product.description: This cable features a grounded IEC 60320 C14 plug on one end and a NEMA® 5‑15R receptacle on the other. It is perfect for extending a standard NEMA 5‑15 to IEC 60320 C13 power cable. It has 18 AWG conductors, making it suitable for general use.
